priya: Hey team, noticed an odd double marketplace charge on the APAC invoice for 'GPUSync Connector' — looks like the same SKU billed twice for the same resource id. attaching a small snippet below. Can someone confirm? :eyes:
billing-bot: New invoice processed for 2026-02. File: invoices/2026-02/apac-2026-02.pdf. Automated line item extract shows duplicate marketplace lines — flagged as possible duplicate.
kevin: I pushed the marketplace image to apac-east2 yesterday and also applied our internal license manifest. Could be a vendor meter + our license billing overlap.
jonathan: Can you paste the exact line items (ids + SKUs)? Need to match to node IDs/instance ids before reaching out to the vendor.
priya: Sure, here's the exact lines I pulled from the CSV: ```
line_item_id,sku,description,amount,resource_id
li-98765,marketplace:gpusync-connector,Marketplace add-on - gpusync,10.00,instance-aps-23a
li-98766,marketplace:gpusync-connector,Marketplace add-on - gpusync,10.00,instance-aps-23a
```
samir: Those look identical except for the line_item_id. I saw a similar pattern with another vendor — marketplace metering records sometimes duplicate when a deploy and a cluster autoscaler event both trigger a registration ping.
alice: @kevin can you share the node bootstrap logs around the deploy time? We should check for duplicate registration calls to the vendor endpoint.
kevin: attaching minimal node list and timestamps: ```
instance-aps-23a boot 2026-02-11T09:12Z
instance-aps-23b boot 2026-02-11T09:14Z
```
jonathan: Also check marketplace account ids in the provider console — sometimes a marketplace listing has both a global SKU and a regional SKU that map to the same product but bill separately. If both were triggered, they would appear as two line items.
priya: I'll open a support case with the cloud provider + vendor. Draft message: "Found duplicate marketplace add-on charges for resource instance-aps-23a (li-98765 & li-98766). Please investigate metering events and reverse the duplicate." Anything to add?
samir: Add the deploy timestamps and the node ids, and ask for the metering event ids for each line_item so we can cross-check on our end.
alice: Also request the vendor-side trace ids — they usually include a request_id that maps to the meter.
priya: Done, support case created: CASE-2026-451. Asked for reversal of li-98766 and the metering logs. Leaving this open until provider confirms. cc @kevin @jonathan :thumbsup:
billing-bot: Support ticket CASE-2026-451 created with provider. Estimated response 72h. Status: open.
priya: Quick cost note — this is ~ $20/day duplicated (small scale now but scales with fleet), so let's flag as priority if it affects autoscaling groups. I'll update once provider responds. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
